tasks[].recover_staged_payload.meaning: Collect the exact physical container marked staged and recovery-required at the specified pickup location.
tasks[].recover_staged_payload.precedence: Default false. True requires a nonempty payload_instance_id and payload; it never creates stock. Uses ordinary route profiles, robot compatibility and destination capacity. Waits until eligible or the original deferral deadline; excludes unconfirmed arrivals. Direct recovery only: no further automatic return or staff handoff.

tasks[].payload_instance_id.meaning: Optional identity of one physical container. Repeated use refers to that same object, not an instruction to duplicate it.
tasks[].payload_instance_id.precedence: An ordinary outbound task may first issue a previously unissued ID. Commitment claims that creation; after physical pickup or seeded storage the ID must be available at the requested source for reuse. Transit, removal and unconfirmed arrival do not permit recreation. Blank ordinary IDs receive unique generated identities. Return tasks normally require existing stock; internally generated staged and service continuations retain their specific policies.

corridors.auto_connect.meaning: Connect otherwise unconnected locations/lifts to the nearest corridor node when enabled.
corridors.auto_connect.validation: If supplied, the value must be an actual JSON boolean; strings, numbers and null are rejected by Project checks, editor loading and simulator construction before coercion.
corridors.auto_connect.limitations: Nearest-node linking is not geometric connectivity validation. New projects explicitly store false; imported omission deliberately retains runtime default true.
corridors.auto_connect.runtime_default: true when omitted in imported/raw configuration
corridors.auto_connect.editor_behaviour: New blank projects specify false. Imported configurations retain omission, so runtime true still applies.
corridors.auto_connect.precedence: Explicit JSON boolean wins. A new editor project explicitly stores false; importing a missing value does not insert that new-project default.

corridors.edges[].distance_m.validation: Raw Project checks require a finite nonnegative number if supplied. Runtime null also falls back; do not rely on direct CLI loading as schema validation.
corridors.edges[].distance_m.limitations: Explicit distance may disagree with drawing geometry. No surveyed-distance validation or acceleration model.
corridors.edges[].distance_m.runtime_default: Endpoint Euclidean distance when omitted or null
corridors.edges[].distance_m.editor_behaviour: Optional explicit distance retained on import.

corridors.edges[].width_m.precedence: Falls back to building.default_corridor_width_m; endpoint doors can reduce it.
corridors.edges[].width_m.validation: Explicit values must convert to a finite positive width; booleans, null, zero and negative values are rejected before import normalisation or simulation. Numeric strings remain accepted. Missing fields use the documented defaults.
corridors.edges[].width_m.limitations: Straight passage only: no safety margin, door height/swing/opening time or swept-footprint check. Both full incident edges inherit a door restriction. Editing controls with a 0.1 m minimum need later consistency review; imported smaller dimensions are not enlarged.
corridors.edges[].width_m.editor_behaviour: Import preserves all positive widths exactly, including below 0.1 m; missing node/edge widths receive the building defaults. Some editing controls still constrain entry to at least 0.1 m.

corridors.edges[].bidirectional.editor_behaviour: Missing edge flag retained; runtime supplies true.

Closed gaps consume no spacing time; each release uses its group ordinal divided by group total across working duration. No overlap retains timeframe-start demand, adjusted to department opening before the exclusive deadline, and flags the fallback in Demand Preview. Disabling spreading does not disable runtime staff hours.

task_generation.staff_config.shift_patte.precedence: Stored custom values cannot override the runtime fixed cycle.

task_generation.staff_config.shift_patte.validation: Finite non-negative whole number, with numeric strings accepted and booleans rejected. Any value other than the pattern default produces GENERATION_UNSUPPORTED in Project checks.
task_generation.staff_config.shift_patte.limitations: General work/rest cycle scheduling is unsupported. Acknowledgement records acceptance of fixed-cycle behavior; it does not implement the requested cycle.

departments[].days_active.runtime_default: Omitted or empty means every weekday.
departments[].days_active.meaning: Permitted department opening-start dates. Overnight openings remain available on the following date; category release-day gates apply separately.
departments[].days_active.precedence: Department opening hours constrain releases after category/group settings are resolved. A category or group cannot override a closed department.
departments[].days_active.editor_behaviour: Import preserves unrestricted weekday semantics. Existing empty lists display all seven checkboxes. New-department defaults still explicitly select Monday-Friday.
departments[].days_active.validation: Reference acceptance covers missing, empty and explicit weekday lists and overnight opening carry-in. General malformed list/value validation is not complete.
departments[].days_active.limitations: Not a staffing calendar or a guarantee of delivery before closure. Additional waste and accumulation-mode interactions remain open.

task_generation.categories.*.department_.limitations: Reference scope includes overnight release dates, fortnight transitions, different department windows and partial-preview slot exclusions. Group ordinals reserve no staff capacity, and excluded slots are not redistributed. Complete accumulation-mode calendar semantics and malformed weekday-list rejection remain open.
task_generation.categories.*.department_.runtime_default: Inherit category setting; explicit empty means every weekday.
task_generation.categories.*.department_.meaning: Weekday gates apply after department-opening adjustment.
task_generation.categories.*.department_.precedence: Effective group or department overrides replace category settings. task_generation.categories.*.department_.editor_behaviour: Missing group value inherits the category. Explicit empty overrides a category restriction and displays all seven days in the bulk editor.

task_generation.categories.*.base_daily_.meaning: Adds rate times eligible elapsed seconds divided by 86400 in continuous, threshold, hybrid and scheduled_threshold modes. Continuous alone stores volume without triggering collections.
task_generation.categories.*.base_daily_.precedence: Category settings are replaced by effective group/department overrides; waste streams have an additional overlay and derived-threshold path. Demand accumulates throughout eligible intervals, while emission waits for an active/open poll.
task_generation.categories.*.base_daily_.editor_behaviour: Finite non-negative values and numeric strings are retained; invalid rates are rejected before template normalisation. Other omitted category defaults and waste-specific derivation need separate acceptance.
task_generation.categories.*.base_daily_.validation: Shared raw checks reject negative, boolean, null and non-finite values. Independent references reconcile accrued/collected/residual volume, event fractions, closed polls, actual weekdays, fortnight blocks and a final partial simulation poll.
task_generation.categories.*.base_daily_.limitations: Rates are scaled per 24 eligible hours, not automatically per department working day. Polls affect release timing. Continuous volume alone does not dispatch. Shared waste pools, legacy waste generation, tracked-item reset/consumption and full hybrid interactions remain open. Numerical tolerance is 1e-12 relative for threshold equality and 1e-10 absolute events for integer extraction.

task_generation.categories.*.department_.validation: Shared raw checks reject negative, boolean, null and non-finite values. Independent references reconcile accrued/collected/residual volume, event fractions, closed polls, actual weekdays, fortnight blocks and a final partial simulation poll.
task_generation.categories.*.department_.limitations: Rates are scaled per 24 eligible hours, not automatically per department working day. Polls affect release timing. Continuous volume alone does not dispatch. Shared waste pools, legacy waste generation, tracked-item reset/consumption and full hybrid interactions remain open. Numerical tolerance is 1e-12 relative for threshold equality and 1e-10 absolute events for integer extraction.

task_generation.categories.*.threshold_v.meaning: Positive values trigger collection records when stored volume reaches the threshold. Each collection removes one threshold volume; any remainder is retained. Zero disables this trigger without deleting accumulated volume.
